title: feat(sankey): Show values
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

Show values with sankey diagrams.
![image](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/assets/10703445/c67835dd-0e77-4c00-8121-673d4c04a571)

Resolves #4674

## :straight_ruler: Design Decisions

Currently, I've added prefix and suffix as config options, but I doubt that's the best approach.

Either, we should support all config values in the frontmatter, which would be a big change.
Or, we could add support for prefix and suffix into the grammar. (Which we can add/remove as sankey is still in beta).

### :clipboard: Tasks

Make sure you

- [x] :book: have read the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md)

- [x] :bookmark: targeted `develop` branch

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body:
@aloisklink I have a query before we release this. Do we need the config key?
The only other keys in frontmatter are title and displayMode, with the addition of config, the chance of us adding a top level frontmatter key is slim. 

So, should we remove the `config` key, and directly write the config at the root?


```suggestion
      sankey:
        showValues: true
        prefix: $
        suffix: B
        width: 800
        nodeAlignment: left
```
